title.narrative: Engaging Danish Students in Global Health

description.narrative:
The project aims to engage Danish master’s students in global health research and cross-cultural collaboration, focusing on hypertension and stroke in Zanzibar.
Project participants: Danish NCD Alliance, Aarhus University and Zanzibar NCD Alliance along with Danish master’s students from Public Health and Medicine at AU and local Zanzibari students.
Activities: -Training of Danish students, including SDG and Zanzibar context. - Four exchange trips to Zanzibar, working in pairs with Zanzibari students. -Joint research on hypertension and stroke, including study design, data collection and community outreach. -Engagement activities in Denmark, including social media campaigns, presentations, and workshops.
Expected Results: -Enhanced global health competencies and cross-cultural understanding among the students. -New data on hypertension and stroke, informing local interventions and policy. -Increased awareness and engagement with the SDGs and global health among Danish youth.
